title: Natyashastra
summary: The Natyashastra is an Indian treatise ascribed to the sage Bharata Muni on dramatic and poetic expression. It covers performance technique, costume, gesture, plot, language and verse, rasa and musical modes in thirty-six sections. Opened pages date it anywhere from the second century BCE to 300 CE.

uncertainty.note: Two opened pages give different ranges: second century BCE to second century CE, and 200 to 300 CE. Start is 200 BCE (astronomical -199).

as_recorded.value: between 200 and 300 C.E.; probably compiled over several centuries
between the second century BCE and the second century CE
